Placeholder

This file exists so that //go:embed all:dist in main.go resolves on a clean checkout. go:embed is a compile-time directive and an empty directory is a build failure, not a smaller binary — so without a committed file here, go build ./... breaks for anyone who has not run site/build.sh first.

The real site is copied over this by docker/Dockerfile.site before the Go build. If you are reading this in a browser, you are looking at an image built without that step.
